card.name: Linking words before seasons and months
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "is" or "and" right after a month, season or holiday cue, where the next word is likely a season, month or observance name.

modes.label: End or start of a season
modes.description: The word "of" after "end" or "beginning" when a season or harvest period comes next.
modes.example: JASPER, Alberta — Autumnal equinox occurred on Saturday, marking the end<< of>> summer and the start of fall.

modes.label: Month awareness listings
modes.description: "is" or "and" after a month name or in a list of monthly observances.
modes.example: American Diabetes Association - May<< is>> Stroke Awareness Month News 10

modes.label: Seasonal holiday timing
modes.description: Words in phrases about holidays and the end of summer, like "before" or "last".
modes.example: A good day to barbeque or get a last trip to the beach in<< before>> school starts.

card.writes: It promotes season words (summer, autumn, winter) and suppresses words about customs and traditions.
card.plain: It fires on little words that lead into a season or a calendar month, such as "the end of" or "May is".
